A few useful answers

Before we
say hello.

Do I need to be a business to help?+

No. Individuals, businesses, and community organizations can start a conversation about supporting the team.

Can I contribute materials or expertise?+

Yes. Tell us what you can offer so we can check whether it fits the team’s current needs. Please contact us before arranging a delivery or visit.

Is there a fixed sponsorship amount?+

We haven’t published fixed tiers. Contact the team to discuss a contribution and a partnership that makes sense for you.

How will my support be recognized?+

We’ll discuss recognition directly and agree on what is appropriate for the contribution. No recognition package is assumed when you contact us.
